Year 6 Life Science — Learning Standards

Curriculum explorer based on the supplied SCES 2 Year 6 sheet. Lesson colours follow the contiguous colour blocks in the source spreadsheet.

Standards Explorer

Each continuous colour block from the spreadsheet is treated as one lesson-period block. A block may contain multiple Learning Standards. Content Standard is displayed once for each consecutive group within that block.

Teaching Ideas & Notes for Implementation

🧠 Human: Nervous system

Use labelled diagrams, simple reaction-time tasks and signal-pathway role play.

Implementation notes

Use safe, non-invasive activities. Discuss how the central and peripheral nervous systems transfer information, and ask pupils to explain why protective habits matter.

🔬 Microorganisms

Use microscope images, case cards and safe observations to discuss useful and harmful effects.

Implementation notes

Do not culture unknown microorganisms or open mould containers in class. Use prepared images or teacher-approved sealed demonstrations and reinforce handwashing.

🐾 Interaction among living things

Classify examples of competition, mutualism, commensalism and parasitism.

Implementation notes

Use local ecosystem examples, picture cards and classification tables. Ask pupils to justify each classification with evidence.

🌿 Preservation and conservation

Create a visual exhibition on threatened or extinct plants and animals.

Implementation notes

Use reliable sources and local examples. Have pupils connect threats, conservation actions and expected effects, then communicate a practical role they can take.
